email.subject: Arctic Works: no reviews showing on Google
email.body:
Dev,

Quick note on Arctic Works' site. Two things are likely costing you calls: there are no customer reviews visible, so people comparing HVAC companies in Harbor Falls have no proof you're reliable before they call. And your homepage title just says the company name, not what you do or where, so you're easy to miss in search results against other local HVAC sites.

Both are fixable without a redesign. Happy to walk through exactly what I'd change, free, in 10 minutes, no pitch. Let me know if you'd like a time.

Alex
